verdict.rationale: A public business-register service could reasonably offer a machine channel with a documented test environment, so this axis applies. The evidence only describes human-facing search portals, a publication platform and load-status notes. Nothing documents a public sandbox, test environment, or even a formal API for end-to-end testing, and the llms.txt probe returned 404.

support.subject: As a developer, a public sandbox or test environment for the service's machine channel is documented — I can exercise the rail end to end before touching production
